component.name: fbadmin
component.summary: Administration and development tool for Firebird SQL

description.p: fbadmin is a pgAdmin-style administration tool for Firebird 3, 4 and 5: an object explorer, DDL extraction, a query tool with plans and transactions, an editable data grid, live monitoring and backup/restore.
fbadmin sends no telemetry. The update check is off unless you turn it on.
